properties.name: mcp.server.base-url
properties.description: Base URL used for MCP server endpoint discovery.

properties.name: mcp.server.message-endpoint
properties.description: MCP message endpoint path.

properties.name: mcp.server.sse-endpoint
properties.description: MCP SSE endpoint path.

properties.name: mcp.server.open-api-path
properties.description: OpenAPI path used for service discovery.

properties.name: mcp.server.discovery-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for MCP service discovery requests.

properties.name: mcp.server.included-services
properties.description: Deprecated. This property has no effect in aggregate-first discovery mode (when mcp.server.aggregate-spec-url is set). Use mcp.server.included-path-prefixes to filter which API paths are exposed as MCP tools.

deprecation.reason: Has no effect in aggregate-first discovery mode. Use included-path-prefixes instead.

properties.name: mcp.server.included-path-prefixes
properties.description: Optional allowlist of API path prefixes to include as MCP tools.

properties.name: mcp.server.aggregate-spec-url
properties.description: URL of the API gateway aggregate OpenAPI spec used for aggregate-first discovery.

properties.name: mcp.server.excluded-path-fragments
properties.description: Path fragment substrings that exclude matching API paths from aggregate MCP tool discovery.

properties.name: mcp.security.permit-all-transport
properties.description: Allow all MCP transport requests without authentication when enabled.

properties.name: mcp.llm.apis
properties.description: Configured LLM API connection profiles used by MCP orchestration.

properties.name: mcp.rag.table-name
properties.description: PostgreSQL table name used for MCP RAG embeddings.

properties.name: mcp.rag.dimension
properties.description: Embedding vector dimension used by MCP RAG storage.

properties.name: mcp.rag.create-table
properties.description: Create RAG table on startup when enabled.

properties.name: mcp.rag.chunking.enabled
properties.description: Enable chunking for ingested RAG documents.

properties.name: mcp.rag.chunking.max-segment-size
properties.description: Maximum RAG chunk segment size in characters.

properties.name: mcp.rag.chunking.max-overlap-size
properties.description: Character overlap size between adjacent RAG chunks.

properties.name: mcp.rag.ingestion.max-concurrency
properties.description: Maximum concurrent background ingestion jobs for RAG embedding.

properties.name: mcp.agent.cache-ttl-minutes
properties.description: Session agent cache TTL in minutes.

properties.name: mcp.agent.max-cached-agents
properties.description: Maximum number of cached session agents.

properties.name: mcp.agent.memory-max-messages
properties.description: Maximum number of remembered messages per cached session.

properties.name: mcp.agent.candidate-tool-limit
properties.description: Maximum candidate tools considered per orchestration turn.

properties.name: mcp.tuning.enabled
properties.description: Enable adaptive MCP tool priority tuning.

properties.name: mcp.tuning.cron
properties.description: Cron expression controlling MCP tuning schedule.

properties.name: mcp.model.fallback.enabled
properties.description: Enable fallback model logic in MCP orchestration.

properties.name: mcp.model.fallback.secondary-model-name
properties.description: Secondary model name used for fallback inference.

properties.name: mcp.model.fallback.timeout
properties.description: Timeout for fallback model responses.

properties.name: pos.nlti.session.ttl-hours
properties.description: Number of hours to retain NLTI sessions.

properties.name: pos.nlti.rate-limit.per-session
properties.description: Maximum NLTI requests allowed per session.

properties.name: pos.nlti.rate-limit.max-tracked-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of NLTI sessions tracked for rate limiting.

properties.name: pos.events.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the pos-events/event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.

properties.name: pos.security.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for permission registration against pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.security.permission-registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable startup permission registration with pos-security-service.

properties.name: exa.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for Exa web search API integration.

properties.name: exa.api-key
properties.description: API key for Exa web search integration.

properties.name: exa.search-type
properties.description: Search type requested from Exa.

properties.name: exa.max-results
properties.description: Maximum number of Exa search results to return.

properties.name: pos.inventory.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for inventory tools.

properties.name: pos.order.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for order tools.

properties.name: pos.customer.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for customer tools.

properties.name: pos.catalog.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for catalog tools.

properties.name: pos.workorder.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for workorder tools.

properties.name: pos.invoice.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for invoice tools.

properties.name: pos.accounting.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for accounting tools.

properties.name: pos.reporting.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for reporting tools.

properties.name: pos.location.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for location tools.

properties.name: pos.shopmanager.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for shop manager tools.

properties.name: pos.tax.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for tax tools (direct Docker DNS; pos-tax is internal-only per ADR-0021 and listens on 8091).

properties.name: pos.vehicle.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for vehicle tools.

properties.name: pos.event-receiver.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for event receiver tools.

properties.name: pos.show-actuator
properties.description: Expose actuator endpoints in the MCP server.

properties.name: mcp.rag.index-type
properties.description: pgvector index type used for RAG embedding similarity search (e.g. ivfflat, hnsw).

properties.name: pos.accounting.account-balance-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a GL account balance from the accounting service (the id is the GL account UUID).

properties.name: pos.accounting.general-ledger-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the general-ledger report backing journal-entry queries (optional accountId appended by the tool).

properties.name: pos.accounting.income-statement-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the income-statement leg of the financial summary composition.

properties.name: pos.accounting.balance-sheet-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the balance-sheet leg of the financial summary composition.

properties.name: pos.accounting.trial-balance-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the trial-balance leg of the financial summary composition (as-of param is asOf, not asOfDate).

properties.name: pos.catalog.product-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single product from the catalog service.

properties.name: pos.catalog.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching the product catalog.

properties.name: pos.catalog.category-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching products by category (category filter on the product search).

properties.name: pos.customer.customer-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single customer record.

properties.name: pos.customer.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching customers.

properties.name: pos.customer.snapshot-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the CRM snapshot leg of the customer history composition.

properties.name: pos.customer.interactions-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the interaction-timeline leg of the customer history composition.

properties.name: pos.customer.invoices-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the cross-domain invoice-lines leg of the customer history composition.

properties.name: pos.customer.workorders-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the cross-domain workorder leg of the customer history composition.

properties.name: pos.event-receiver.event-types-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching registered event types from the event receiver.

properties.name: pos.event-receiver.summary-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the event summary window (lastHour, lastDay, or lastWeek; validated in the tool).

properties.name: pos.event-receiver.history-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for per-entity event history (#1521 restoration); since, page, and size all default server-side.

properties.name: pos.inventory.stock-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching stock availability by SKU from the inventory service.

properties.name: pos.inventory.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching inventory availability by SKU (optional locationId and sourceType appended by the tool).

properties.name: pos.inventory.location-stock-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the inventory inquiry at a specific location.

properties.name: pos.invoice.invoice-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single invoice.

properties.name: pos.invoice.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching invoices.

properties.name: pos.invoice.customer-invoices-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a customer's invoice line items (de-duplicated by owning invoice in the facade).

properties.name: pos.location.location-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single location record.

properties.name: pos.location.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the zero-parameter location roster; the facade filters by name/code in-process.

properties.name: pos.location.inventory-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the inventory inquiry at a specific location (cross-domain /inventory route).

properties.name: pos.order.order-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single order.

properties.name: pos.order.list-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for listing orders (optional status, clerkId, and terminalId appended by the tool).

properties.name: pos.pricing.base-url
properties.description: Facade base URL for pricing tools.

properties.name: pos.pricing.product-search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the detailed catalog search leg of the SKU price composition (sku= filter, detailed=true carries the active MSRP).

properties.name: pos.pricing.effective-price-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the optional location effective-price leg of the SKU price composition.

properties.name: pos.pricing.promotion-by-code-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a promotion offer by its code.

properties.name: pos.pricing.price-restrictions-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for listing price restriction rules.

properties.name: pos.pricing.price-list-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a price book by ID (catalog is the system of record per ADR-0054).

properties.name: pos.reporting.sales-report-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the income-statement report backing the sales report (the tool maps its period argument onto the date range).

properties.name: pos.reporting.inventory-report-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the location inventory-rollup report (served by pos-inventory).

properties.name: pos.reporting.aged-receivables-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the aged-receivables leg of the revenue report composition.

properties.name: pos.security.users.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the security service users API (via gateway).

properties.name: pos.security.audit.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the security service audit API (via gateway).

properties.name: pos.security.user-permissions-path-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching permissions for a specific user.

properties.name: pos.security.audit-search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching audit events by event type.

properties.name: pos.hr.employee-base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the HR employee API (via gateway).

properties.name: pos.hr.availability-base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the HR availability API (via gateway).

properties.name: pos.hr.employee-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching an employee record by ID.

properties.name: pos.hr.schedule-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching employee availability/schedule.

properties.name: pos.hr.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching employees by name or employee number (#1523 restoration).

properties.name: pos.shopmanager.location-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the cross-domain location leg of the shop status composition (a shopId is a locationId).

properties.name: pos.shopmanager.schedule-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the schedule-board leg of the shop status/queue compositions (date is required downstream).

properties.name: pos.shopmanager.wip-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the cross-domain open-workorder (WIP) leg of the shop status/queue compositions.

properties.name: pos.shopmanager.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the cross-domain location roster used to search shops (shops are locations; name/code filter applied in-process).

properties.name: pos.tax.gateway-base-url
properties.description: Gateway base URL for the tax facade legs pos-tax does not serve (location lookup, accounting tax-liability summary).

properties.name: pos.tax.location-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the gateway location-lookup leg of the tax calculation composition.

properties.name: pos.tax.tax-calculate-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the direct pos-tax calculation POST (ADR-0021); the request body carries the line item and destination address.

properties.name: pos.tax.tax-summary-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the accounting tax-liability report backing the tax summary (load-balanced gateway client, not the direct pos-tax client).

properties.name: pos.tax.rates-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for the direct pos-tax rate lookup (ADR-0021, #1522 restoration), relative to pos.tax.base-url; countryCode and postalCode are always appended, regionCode and city only when the resolved location supplies them.

properties.name: pos.vehicle.vehicle-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single vehicle record.

properties.name: pos.vehicle.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching vehicle records.

properties.name: pos.vehicle.customer-vehicles-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching all vehicles belonging to a customer.

properties.name: pos.workorder.workorder-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching a single workorder by ID.

properties.name: pos.workorder.search-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for searching workorders.

properties.name: pos.workorder.status-uri-template
properties.description: URI template for fetching the status of a specific workorder (same endpoint as the workorder fetch; the response's status field answers the intent).

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Ollama server used for the primary chat model.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model
properties.description: Ollama model name used for chat completions.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.temperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature for the Ollama chat model (0.0–1.0).

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.chat.timeout
properties.description: Request timeout for the Ollama chat model.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Ollama server used for the embedding model.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.options.model
properties.description: Ollama model name used for generating embeddings.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.timeout
properties.description: Request timeout for the Ollama embedding model.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.chat.streaming-timeout
properties.description: Request timeout for the Ollama streaming chat model.

properties.name: mcp.rag.preload.docs
properties.description: List of RAG documents to preload into the vector store on startup.

properties.name: mcp.rag.preload.docs[].id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the preloaded RAG document. Used for idempotent upsert.

properties.name: mcp.rag.preload.docs[].source-path
properties.description: Resource path of the RAG document to ingest (e.g. classpath:rag/my-doc.md).

properties.name: mcp.rag.preload.docs[].rag-scope
properties.description: Scope tag applied to the preloaded document for scoped retrieval (e.g. accounting, inventory, master).
